visual_observation.source: Two cua_repl Bambu Studio Device live-camera frames; visible Mark1 name and exact archive confirmed
visual_observation.body: First-layer region visible behind/beneath the moving toolhead. Clear PETG and reflected illumination prevent a reliable complete corner-contact assessment. No definite displaced body edge identified.
visual_observation.cap: Complete cap perimeter and bed contact are not yet clearly assessable in these early deposition frames.
visual_observation.finding: No confirmed lift or nozzle strike in inspected frames. This is not an established attached-corner baseline; last-attached and first-lifted bounds remain unset.

mapping_assessment: AMS unit 0 tray 1 is current and target; right extruder snow=1 and mounted hnow=0 corresponds to nozzle 0, diameter 0.8 mm. A2 mapping is confirmed at deposition.
timelapse_assessment: Runtime timelapse reports enable at layer 1.
